rationale: In AddCpu (L97-L105), time.Now() is assigned to Usage.Time and marshaled into usageByte which is written via PutState. In AddUsage (L143-L153), time.Now() similarly updates usageVal.Time before PutState. Both create nondeterministic ledger writes. GetHistory only returns data without influencing writes, so C4 does not apply.
